_meta.description: budget-scenarios — the what-if layer of begroting (REQ-BSC-001..010). BudgetScenario (a named cluster of dated modifiers, at most one default per administration, draft→active→archived) and BudgetScenarioModifier (RECURRING_END / RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE / LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA, each dated). Neither schema extends CashflowScenario (bookkeeping-cashflow-13wk) — that schema is week-numbered, horizon-bound, has no isDefault field, and is left completely untouched by this change (design.md §1). RULING 1 (2026-08-20): this fragment also seeds exactly one balance-sheet LedgerGroup ("Liquide middelen", VLA-LIQ, accountRange 1000-1099, sourced from rj270-balance-sheet.json) so LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA has a real target on a fresh import — budget-core-schema's own P&L-only default seed is not touched or reversed (design.md §4c).

BudgetScenario.title: Budget Scenario
BudgetScenario.description: A named cluster of dated BudgetScenarioModifiers compared side-by-side against the real AnnualBudget/BudgetLine data, never mutating it. At most one BudgetScenario per administrationId may carry isDefault=true, enforced by BudgetScenarioDefaultPromoter's atomic-demotion service call — not a lifecycle transition, because demoting a DIFFERENT sibling object cannot be expressed as a single-object x-openregister-lifecycle precondition (design.md §2a, §3b).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this scenario belongs to. The one-default invariant is scoped to this field alone, not to any fiscal year — a scenario's own modifiers may span multiple fiscal years (design.md §2b).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

name.description: Operator-facing scenario name, e.g. "Sell product X".
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional free-text description of what this scenario models.
description.example: Two employees leave, hosting recurring cost drops, and €50,000 moves to the bank on 2027-09-01.
description.title: Description

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default scenario shown when nobody explicitly picked one. Set exclusively via BudgetScenarioDefaultPromoter::promote(), which atomically demotes any previously-default scenario for the same administrationId in the same service call. When zero scenarios carry isDefault=true, no scenario overlay is applied anywhere — the real AnnualBudget/BudgetLine data is shown unmodified (design.md §3c).
isDefault.title: Is Default

status.description: Lifecycle state. draft: being composed, modifiers editable. active: available for comparison, modifiers still editable. archived: retired, retained for audit, no longer selectable for comparison.
status.title: Status

active.label: Active
active.description: Available for comparison; modifiers still editable.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retired; retained for audit, no longer selectable for comparison.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a BudgetScenario is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

BudgetScenarioModifier.title: Budget Scenario Modifier
BudgetScenarioModifier.description: One dated modifier belonging to one BudgetScenario: RECURRING_END (a CashflowRecurring row's schedule hypothetically capped at effectiveDate — models "employee A+B leave the org" as GL-recognised cost lines ending, never as an HR concept), RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE (a CashflowRecurring row's standardAmount hypothetically replaced from effectiveDate forward — "recurring drops X from date X"), or LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA (a one-off signed adjustment to one LedgerGroup for effectiveDate's own month only — "amount X transferred to the bank at date X"). BudgetScenarioModifierGuard rejects two RECURRING_* modifiers in the same scenario targeting the same targetRecurId with overlapping effect (REQ-BSC-004, ADR-031 exception path); everything else sums additively, order-independent, at evaluation time.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this modifier (denormalised, matching every reviewed schema in this codebase).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

modifierType.description: Which of the three dated modifier kinds this row expresses (design.md §4b).
modifierType.title: Modifier Type

effectiveDate.description: The dated-modifier anchor. For RECURRING_END, the hypothetical validTo cap. For RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE, the date newStandardAmount starts applying from. For LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA, the single calendar month amountDeltaCents applies to.
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

targetRecurId.description: FK to CashflowRecurring.recurId (budget-known-costs's own dated planned-cost primitive). Required for RECURRING_END/RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE; unused for LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA. This change never declares a second dated-cost primitive.
targetRecurId.title: Target Recurring Cost ID

newStandardAmount.description: Required for RECURRING_AMOUNT_CHANGE: the replacement standardAmount from effectiveDate forward. Stores the resulting absolute amount, matching CashflowRecurring.standardAmount's own absolute-value convention, not a delta.
newStandardAmount.title: New Standard Amount

targetLedgerGroupId.description: Required for LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA: FK to the LedgerGroup this one-off adjustment targets.
targetLedgerGroupId.title: Target Ledger Group ID

amountDeltaCents.description: Required for LEDGER_AMOUNT_DELTA: signed adjustment in EUR cents, applied to effectiveDate's own calendar month only — a genuinely one-time event, not a step change carried forward.
amountDeltaCents.title: Amount Delta (cents)

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a BudgetScenarioModifier is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
